title: Structure Prediction and Molecular Docking
description: Predict protein 3D structure (AlphaFold3/Chai-1/Boltz-2) and dock small molecule ligands using DiffDock or Vina.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

fasta_input.description: FASTA file or inline sequence for structure prediction. Provide either this or json.

ligand_sdf.description: Ligand SDF file for molecular docking step.

json.description: AlphaFold3 JSON input file (alternative to fasta_input for AF3 server mode).

af3_mode.description: AlphaFold3 prediction mode. 'server' uses alphafoldserver.com API (requires token); 'local' uses on-premise weights.

af3_api_token.description: Bearer token for alphafoldserver.com. Required for af3_mode=server.

af3_num_recycles.description: Number of recycling iterations for structure refinement. More = higher accuracy but slower.

diffdock_poses.description: Number of docked poses DiffDock generates.

diffdock_inference_steps.description: Diffusion model inference steps. More = better pose quality but slower.

vina_exhaustiveness.description: AutoDock Vina search exhaustiveness. Higher = more thorough grid search.

vina_num_modes.description: Number of binding modes (poses) Vina reports.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
